verdict.rationale: Skyfire lets merchants identify agents and agent platforms through attached kya tokens, so a site or the bot manager in front of it can allow them through. Sellers can also set identity requirements on a service, and token creation fails for buyers below the required verification level. That amounts to coarse, verification-level gating, and the actual allow/block decision is described as happening in the merchant's own bot manager rather than in Skyfire. Missing for 10: per-agent or per-platform allow/deny lists, any rate-limiting controls, merchant-side policy configuration for catalog vs. checkout access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
